cohort: 207 mothers with children aged 0-12 months attending a Maternal and Child Health (MCH) Clinic at a tertiary care referral hospital.
finding: Less than half of newborns (47.3%) received breast milk within the first hour of birth.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with delayed initiation of breastfeeding.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was associated with delayed initiation of breastfeeding
